metadata.source: NBA official 2026-27 Regular Season Schedule By Date (final for release as of Aug. 13, 2026)
metadata.schedule_note: The NBA has assigned dates/opponents for 80 games per team. Two games per team (30 total league games) during Dec. 4-10 depend on NBA Cup Group Play results and are not yet assigned.

derived_field_definitions.back_to_back: Previous scheduled game is on the immediately preceding calendar day.
derived_field_definitions.three_in_four: At least 3 team games in the 4-calendar-day window ending on this game date.
derived_field_definitions.five_in_seven: At least 5 team games in the 7-calendar-day window ending on this game date.
derived_field_definitions.first_home_after_5plus_road_games: Actual home-arena game immediately following at least 5 consecutive games not played in the team home arena.
derived_field_definitions.one_game_homestand: Actual home-arena game with both the immediately previous and next scheduled games outside the team home arena.
derived_field_definitions.crossing_multiple_time_zones: Absolute venue UTC-offset change from previous game is at least 2 hours on the relevant game dates.
derived_field_definitions.awkward_start_time: Preliminary rule: venue-local tip before 1:00 PM or at/after 10:00 PM; intended to be tunable later.
derived_field_definitions.miles_traveled_from_previous_game: Great-circle (haversine) miles from previous game venue to current game venue; null for season opener.
derived_field_definitions.home_arena_advantage: Reserved nullable field for later modeling.
